⛔ **Governed surface (`.claude/**`).** This PR stays a draft until an APPROVED review from an authorized approver (os-zhuang or hotlong) is on record; the merge-queue leg of the Governed Surface Queue Guard refuses it otherwise. No agent seat approves it.

## What changes

Round 2 (b) of objectui-readiness 3. `.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/verify/SKILL.md` gain `metadata: internal: true` in their frontmatter, with a comment saying why. The merged objectstack repo's create-objectstack test ("skills catalog boundary") requires that marker on every SKILL.md outside the published `skills/` catalog, so a repo-root `npx skills add` never offers these repo-internal skills to customers. Both stay internal (Tesla's decision D, 2026-10-25). `skills/objectui/SKILL.md` is not touched: it moves into objectstack's root `skills/` catalog in the cutover commit. `packages/plugin-dashboard/SKILL.md` got the same marker in objectui#13512.

Frontmatter only: +8 lines, no instruction text changes.
